final_evidence: Searches made by the builder and the reviewers (not repeated in this finalisation):

status.chip: Found its test world. Distance only rough.
status.headline: Result: the tool found Eris, a world known since 2005, and measured its distance roughly.
status.source: the module's checks A1 and A2 (place within 4 arcsec, S/N at least 12); the spec's words

candidate.verdict: known distant body (136199 Eris, JPL Horizons within 60 arcsec): known-answer, not a candidate

first_day.source: docs/reflex.md (a review measurement, not re-run by the module)

limit.flux_scale: matched filter (Eris's mean_flux_mjy is on the same scale)
limit.distance_range_note: the near end is where the search starts; the far end is the nearest non-zero 1/d of the coarse grid: beyond it a body is found but cannot be told from one at infinity. It is NOT the ranging limit (see ranging_limit_au).

ranging_limit_au.source: backend/reflex.py RANGING_NOTE (scaled from the measured Eris profile)

limit.injection_why: docs/reflex/results.json holds no injection-recovery test; the limit is the S/N threshold times the measured noise, a 50 per cent level

sedna.found_blind_rule: false while the module's Sedna check passed (no vetted candidate and forced S/N below the threshold); null otherwise

demo.made_from_note: each exposure (IMAGE minus ZODI minus its clipped median sky, flagged pixels left out) minus the mean of the same two other-visit exposures the search subtracted, blank where the search's own difference map is blank (bright fixed stars)
demo.resampling: bilinear, onto one north-up east-left grid of 6.15 arcsec squares (as the module samples its maps)

stretch.formula: grey = 255 * clip((v - lo) / (hi - lo), 0, 1); blank pixels (no data, or blanked by the search) are drawn at the grey of the plain mean's median
stretch.rule: lo = the plain mean's median - 2 robust sigma, hi = its median + 8 robust sigma; the same for all three pictures

single.rule: the used exposure nearest the middle of the visit

slid.rule: each exposure sampled at its own place on the module's best track (place, drift and 1/d of the refined fit), so Eris piles up at its place at the reference time

demo.star_trail_rule: the plain mean slid along the same track; a trail crosses Eris if that picture exceeds 3 x the slid picture's robust noise within 1 square of Eris's place

marks.units: picture pixels, x right and y down from the top-left corner; pixel (0, 0) spans 0..1

meter_basis: snr and delta: S/N with place and drift free at each 1/d (reflex.profile with no drift box), the same rule as the module's straight-track test; *_module_profile: the module's published profile (drift box per 1/d) interpolated, except No bend, which is the module's straight track

wrong_way.rule: kept while delta(wrong way) < 0 and S^2(best) - S^2(no bend) >= MEASURED_DELTA_S2 (9)

blank_field_raw_peaks.note: raw peaks; every one at 8 or more was removed by the other-visit test or the vetoes

development_object_evidence: The analysis choices (3 and 1.5 arcsec grids, drift step, template of two exposures, 0.5 mJy mask, the drift box, the noise calibration and the acceptance lines) were made after a probe had already found Eris; they are not blind to the answer.
